{{Quote|You've been ''betrayed''. You're one of us now, Jedi&mdash;an unwanted outcast.|Gaan, to Joc Sah|<ref name="TOoO" />}}
'''Gaan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who led a [[Gaan's settlement|settlement]] of [[Gaan's outcasts|pariahs]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, he and his group fought the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] of the Galactic Republic.

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Joc Sah]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] arrived on the planet in order to capture Gaan's village, where they confronted Gaan and the other outcasts. However, [[Remy (clone trooper)|Sah's clone sergeant]] then received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], labeling the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Treason/Legends|traitors]] to the Republic, and [[Battle of Ragmar V|attacked]] Sah. Gaan and Sah combined their forces and [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] the Padawan's former allies. As Sah attempted to contact his [[Sev (Jedi)|Jedi Master]], Gaan informed the Jedi that he had been betrayed and offered him a place in his group. Sah accepted, and the two led the outcasts against the detachment of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] that were dispatched to ensure Sah's demise.

==Biography==
===Defending Ragmar V===
{{Quote|We're in for a tough fight, but we will stand our ground. They want to bring their war to our home&hellip; then repay them in kind.|Gaan to the Rodian and several other pariahs|<ref name="TOoO" />}}
[[File:GaanAndHisBand.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Gaan with his gang]]
Gaan,<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="TOoO" /> lived during the [[Great Peace of the Republic|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], he became the leader of a [[Gaan's outcasts|group]] of outcasts on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[The Order of Outcasts]]" takes place during the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Galactic Republic sought to establish an outpost on Ragmar V, which was considered an essential staging planet for their planned assault of a [[Unidentified Separatist base (Sev)|Separatist base]]. When a Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] landed on a cliff near [[Gaan's settlement]], the leader instructed two of his subordinates to use a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] to destroy the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="TOoO" /> 

After the gunship was destroyed, Gaan told his group to prepare for the [[Battle of Ragmar V|coming battle]] with approaching Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] and ordered his group to leave the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for him to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]]. Gaan met Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Joc Sah]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the settlement, informing the Jedi that the Republic was not welcome on the planet.<ref name="TOoO" />

===Order 66===
{{Quote|The enemy of your enemy is your friend. We're all you've got now.|Gaan, to Joc Sah|<ref name="TOoO" />}}
[[File:GaanJocJoinForce.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Gaan and Joc Sah join forces against the clone troopers]]
As Gaan prepared to do battle with Sah's forces, one of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Remy (clone trooper)|Remy]], received a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|command]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] instructing him to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which labeled the Jedi [[Treason/Legends|traitors]] to the Republic and requiring them to be killed immediately. The [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] opened fire on Sah, much to Gaan's surprise. The leader exclaimed that the Jedi was his to kill and shot one of the clones, causing the rest to return fire at him.<ref name="TOoO" /> 

Gaan took cover in the same building that Sah was in as his group responded by attacking the clones. After Sah attempted to contact his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Sev (Jedi)|Sev]], Gaan offered him the option of either fighting alongside him and his people, or staying in the building and getting killed. Sah agreed to temporarily ally with Gaan, and the two eliminated Sah's former clone allies.<ref name="TOoO" />

When Sah tried one last time to contact his Jedi Master, Gaan noted that the Padawan had been betrayed and was now in Gaan and his group's position of being a pariah, with a common enemy. The Padawan accepted a place in Gaan's group and warned him that the Republic would send an overwhelming number of [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to fight them. Shortly afterward, Gaan and Sah led their fellow pariahs against the troopers from [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Sev's ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], sent to make sure that Sah was eliminated.<ref name="TOoO" /> Both survived and orchestrated a number of hit-and-run attacks against the clones.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|123|Sah, Joc}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They'll be sending troops&hellip;more than we can handle.''"<br />"''Do we look the type that run away from a fight?|Joc Sah and Gaan|<ref name="TOoO" />}}
[[File:Joc_sah.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Joc Sah and Gaan attacking clone troopers]]
Gaan had light skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and heavy stubble. He had a green right [[Eye/Legends|eye]], but his left eye was covered by a red [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] device. Gaan was not sympathetic to the Republic and its forces and sought to fight their troops in retaliation for bringing the war to his and his group's home.<ref name="TOoO" /> 

Gaan was also eager to fight Joc Sah, instructing his group during the battle to leave the Jedi to him. He even went so far as to shoot one of the clone troopers when they attacked the Jedi in accordance with Order 66. After the clones attacked Sah, Gaan was willing to allow the Jedi to temporarily ally with him, and after defeating the clones together, Gaan recognized that Sah had been betrayed, offering his friendship to the Jedi.<ref name="TOoO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Gaan was a warrior with the skills needed to successfully perform hit-and-run attacks against groups of clone troopers.<ref name="TOoO" />

==Equipment==
Gaan wore a yellow earring in his right [[Ear/Legends|ear]], a tattered green [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] over a tan [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], a brown [[Harness/Legends|harness]], and brown pants. He also wore a brown [[Holster/Legends|holster]], a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with a circular buckle, two [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoliers]], black [[boot]]s, and a black fingerless [[Glove/Legends|glove]] on his right [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. A brown pouch and gray cylinder were attached to his belt along with a gray box with a wire that attached to his cybernetic prosthetic. Gaan owned a handheld [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TOoO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gaan first appeared, albeit unidentified in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[The Order of Outcasts]]," which was one of four stories compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] trade paperbacks<ref name="TOoO" /> published on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-402/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-5-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 5 TPB}}</ref> The story was written by [[Matt Jacobs]] and drawn by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]].<ref name="TOoO" /> The character was identified by name when he received an entry in [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> Joc Sah's entry in that book states that Gaan, the Padawan, and the other criminals fled into the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] after fleeing Remy and his troops.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> This contradicts the information given in "The Order of Outcasts," which depicts the characters staying in the village after defeating Remy's clones, and then preparing for the clone detachment sent to eliminate Sah.<ref name="TOoO" />
